prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE new full-body version of THIS exact blond dual-wield warrior in EXACTLY THE SAME battle-ready pose and front-right THREE-QUARTER camera facing SCREEN RIGHT, but change BODY PROPORTIONS ONLY to tall natural young-adult ILLUSTRATION PROPORTIONS while KEEPING THE SD DRAWING STYLE. This is a hybrid requested deliberately: SD/anime face drawing, simplified clean pixel/cel linework and broad faceted material shading, combined with adult illustration body anatomy. Not a chibi body. Not photorealistic, not a different realistic painting.
Most important visible change: head is substantially SMALLER RELATIVE TO BODY, longer naturally proportioned torso, arms, thighs and lower legs. Standing anatomical construction approximately6.5 head units as a design aim, not a rule; the existing crouch naturally reduces displayed height. Do not keep the original3-head chibi anatomy. Preserve stylized youthful almond brown eyes, golden layered spiky hair, simplified SD facial features and determined closed-mouth expression without making him older, muscular hulking or realistic. Keep the established stepped pixel-cluster contour, silver broad cel facets, blue cloth shadow blocks, brown leather blocks and clean controlled linework; avoid smooth vector or soft realistic gradients.
LOCK THE POSE: same focus toward an imagined enemy off-screen RIGHT. Head/chest/pelvis/feet yaw front three-quarter~45deg, both eyes remain visible. Same low braced ready guard with both knees bent and feet spread/planted. Near anatomical RIGHT plated leg trails to screen LEFT, far LEFT blue-cloth boot leads toward screen RIGHT, preserving this exact stance and original anatomical sides. Torso leans slightly forward; maintain the same joint bend directions and weight-bearing intent as reference while naturally lengthening limbs. Not a new lunge, walking stride, strike, jump or straight upright stance. RIGHT arm extends a bent-elbow longsword guard forward diagonally up toward screen RIGHT at lower-chest level, LEFT hand holds the short dagger close to upper chest angled right/up. Preserve the same arm/weapon relationships and readable separation, not a different attack. Exactly two arms, two hands, one longsword, one dagger. Natural wrists/palms/fingers wrap actual grips; no gripping blades or extra limbs.
DESIGN LOCK: silver faceted armor, anatomical RIGHT crescent pauldron and plated shin/boot, LEFT blue wrapped boot with metal buckles/protectors; blue scarf/SHORT lowered hood, blue waist cloth, brown double belts/pouch/trousers. Same RIGHT-hand LONGSWORD with BLUE DIAGONAL blade decorations, silver WING guard and RING knuckle protector; LEFT-hand short angular dagger with small guard. Scale equipment and costume naturally for longer adult-proportioned anatomy; retain exact recognizable motifs/colors and no redesign. No cape/helmet/new equipment/motifs. Same young male identity.
Full body and entire two weapon tips/hair/elbows/boots INSIDE a roomy frame, adjust canvas composition for taller anatomy without cropping. Genuine alpha-transparent background, no enemy drawn, no scene/ground, no glow/halo/shadow/effects/text/labels/watermarks. One finished colored pose still, not a sheet. The SD visual language must remain, but the head-to-body/torso/limb proportions must unmistakably read as a full character ILLUSTRATION rather than SD chibi.
